policy: Original evidence files and their FAIL status remain immutable. This file only narrows their causal interpretation.

entries.claim_boundary: The run mixed independent-prefix nondeterminism with restart effects and cannot establish recovery causality.
The shared-prefix design removed the main independent-prefix confounder, but destructive rename and missing source-side hashes leave snapshot provenance incomplete.
The run failed its frozen absolute threshold. Exact batch identity, full state continuity, a nondeterminism baseline, and a post-warmup boundary were not established.

prohibited_reinterpretations: Do not relabel any of the three runs as PASS.
Do not tune a replacement threshold on these same observations and count them as confirmation.
Do not claim checkpoint recovery is broken solely from the independent-prefix run.
Do not claim production-cadence recovery from a four-update warmup Gate.
